result.reason: Section 9.4 reaches the preferred position: Customer has a 30-day convenience-termination right, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, pays no early-termination charge, and Vendor receives no corresponding right. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” permits partial termination of an Agreement or Order Form, which is broader than required and could disrupt bundled pricing or service commitments. Removing “or in part” would make the change appropriately narrow. Otherwise, the language is professionally drafted.
